name: Dumb
source:
You will embody Dumb, a very wisdom-lacking character. Your goal is to survive during 7 days in a school filled with danger. But this danger is hidden by a whole other truth… will you know how to find the answer?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mushi/dumb/description]Kickstarter campaign[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演Dumb，一个不怎么聪明的角色。你的目标是在一所危机四伏的学校里生存七天。然而，这些危险的背后还隐藏着另一番真相……你能找到答案吗？

（来源：[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mushi/dumb/description]Kickstarter众筹项目[/url]）
